messages:
Eli Z.: Quick experiment: enable a 35s "grace_window" that delays assignment until enrichment completes. Canary 15% traffic for 30min. Sharing details here.
Marin P.: 35s seems okay but what's our fallback? we don't want leads stuck forever.
Sophie L.: Fallback = overflow round-robin after 35s + set lead.property(fallback_reason)=ENRICH_GRACE_EXPIRED. Also tag lead.meta=grace_experiment for filtering.
Andre C.: Can we pause automated outbound drips for grace_experiment leads until owner is confirmed? keeps prospects from getting duplicate contact.
Eli Z.: Yes pause drips. Also we'll set fallback_notified=false and flip to true when queue assign happens.
Marin P.: HubSpot workflow snippet for the playbook docs:
```
Trigger: Contact created
Condition: context.inbound == true
Action: delay 35s
Branch: if property(enriched) == true -> action:set owner via Smart Assign
Else -> action: assign queue "Overflow RR"; set property(fallback_reason)=ENRICH_GRACE_EXPIRED; set property(experiment_tag)=grace_experiment
```
Sophie L.: Salesforce mapping: create boolean field Experiment_Grace__c and Fallback_Flag__c. Keep Original_Owner__c empty if fallback so attribution stays to system queue.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow "Grace Window Handoff" created by Eli Z. (ID: 20567)
Andre C.: Observability plan: dashboard widgets for assign_latency_p50/p95, enrichment_completion_rate, and grace_fallback_rate. Add alert: grace_fallback_rate > 0.08 for 10m -> page #marketing-oncall.
Marin P.: Also soft-alert at 25s for any lead waiting longer so SDR Rotation can optionally pick it up if they opted in.
SDR Rotation: SDR rotation acknowledged. We'll pause drips and mute lead scoring triggers for experiment leads.
Eli Z.: Runbook before go: mute expected alerts, verify HS webhook secrets, add quick rollback to disable grace flag, notify SDR rotation and sales ops.
Sophie L.: Autoscale note: if enrichment queue backlog > 200, auto-short wait to 15s. We'll wire that signal into the workflow via a feature flag.
Marin P.: Can we capture metric: percent_assigned_after_enrichment vs percent_fallback to show win? want a before/after baseline.
Andre C.: Yes, we'll capture baseline for 48h before canary.
Eli Z.: Rolling in 10m. I'll ping @here at T-2 and post dashboard links. Keep messages short in thread during canary so alerts stand out.
Marin P.: Cool. If fallback_rate spikes we'll rollback immediately.
Sophie L.: Thanks team. I'll update the inbound routing playbook with examples and tag docs-changes. :memo:
